title: antidesma cubanum
intro: Antidesma cubanum, commonly known as the Cuban plum or Cuban mango tree, is a species of flowering plant in the family Phyllanthaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include treating fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Antidesma cubanum include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. The health benefits of this plant are thought to be due to its ability to reduce inflammation, prevent cell damage, and inhibit the growth of microorganisms.
